page.overview:
Who is Best Tiger?

Best Tiger is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 3 and onwards.

He is a gunfighter/martial-artist superhero.

Best Tiger's info and origins are entirely unknown, but he was born in Hong Kong, China, and is a master ninja alongside a master marksman/gunman. While having perfect vision, he wears a blindfold as a self-imposed challenge to make fights more difficult, not because he needs it.

Best Tiger had discovered Capevincible had invaded Hong Kong; who greeted him rather cheerfully. Managing to evade him, Tiger then used the infrastructure around him to ricochet a shot that surprisingly sent Capevincible flying back.
